segments.contextAfter: Because many of the lighting effects in a scene are static—that is, the positions of lights relative to the surfaces they illuminate do not change over time—you can achieve high-fidelity lighting effects with little render-time performance cost by using this method to precalculate (or “bake”) light information into a mesh.
